{{Quote|I could tell you how many gokobs are stealing potams from the kitchen.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to [[Salle Serpa]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>}}
A '''potam''' was an edible foodstuff served at the [[Jedi academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. [[Gokob]]s, a rodent species native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], liked to steal them from the Academy's kitchen.

==Behind the scenes==
Potams are mentioned briefly in an exchange between [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Galactic Alliance Guard|commando]] [[Salle Serpa]] in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]'' by [[Troy Denning]], released in [[2007]].
